d: For over six decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. The Group, in its endeavour to excel as a hybrid retailer, has reinforced its distribution and marketing services with a portfolio of eight owned brands and over 300 international brands in the luxury, beauty, fashion, and art de vivre categories. More recently, the Group expanded its expertise into new categories of luxury watches, jewellery, and eyewear.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken with the customer at heart. Be it constantly reinventing itself or focusing on innovation to provide luxury experiences at over 750+ experiential retail stores, online and through mobile apps, each touch point leads to delighting the customer.

Today, Chalhoub Group stands for 14,000 skilled and talented professionals across seven countries, whose cohesive efforts have resulted in the Group being ranked third in the Middle East and first in Saudi Arabia as a Great Place to Work®.

To keep the innovation journey going, the Group has set up “The Greenhouse”, which is not just an innovation hub, but also an incubator space and accelerator for start-ups and small businesses in the region and internationally. This is just one of the several initiatives taken by the Group to reinvent itself, catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. The Group has also been embedding sustainability at the core of its business strategy with a clear commitment towards people, partners and the planet, and by being a member of the United Nations Global Compact Community and signatory of the Women's Empowerment Principles.

r: Our Beauty Consultant is responsible for delivering outstanding customer service to all customers and to use appropriate sales techniques and product knowledge to reach sales targets. Our Beauty Consultant is accountable for counter cleanliness, stock replenishment, handling new launches, promotion of products and merchandising. Our Consultant is also required to maintain high levels of standards in terms of grooming.

As a Beauty Consultant, you’ll create memorable beauty experiences by understanding each customer’s needs and recommending the right products. You’ll bring the brand to life, build lasting customer relationships, achieve sales goals, and keep the counter beautifully presented, well stocked, and ready to welcome customers.
Be the brand expert: Deliver Makeup/Fragrances consultations, product demonstrations, and personalised recommendations.
Drive brand results: Support sales targets, customer acquisition, loyalty, product launches, and brand activations.
Build strong partnerships: Work closely with retail teams and store management to ensure the brand is visible, well presented, and customer-ready.
Stay connected: Build customer relationships through clienteling and keep up to date with beauty trends, products, and competitors.

d: We are seeking a proactive, experienced, and results-oriented HR Generalist to oversee and manage our HR operations in Oman.

This role goes beyond traditional HR administration, requiring a hands-on professional who can independently manage local HR operations, ensure compliance with Omani labour laws, and support the company's business growth and localization objectives.

The successful candidate will serve as a key liaison between regional HR, local management, employees, and government authorities, ensuring effective implementation of corporate HR policies while adapting to local regulatory requirements and business needs.
q: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum 2 years of hands-on HR experience in Oman, preferably in a generalist or HR operations role.
Strong practical knowledge of Omani Labour Law, Omanisation requirements, WPS, and work permit and visa procedures.
Proven experience working with Omani government authorities, particularly the Ministry of Labour and relevant immigration authorities.
Fluency in both English and Arabic, written and spoken, is essential.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of independently managing multiple HR priorities.
Proactive and hands-on, with the ability to establish, improve, and implement HR processes in a growing business environment.
Previous HR experience in the renewable energy, engineering, construction, or project-based industries.
Experience working in a multinational company or supporting regional HR operations.
Familiarity with HRIS platforms and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
r: Manage end-to-end recruitment processes, with a strong focus on achieving and maintaining Omanisation requirements.
Develop and maintain local talent pipelines through recruitment channels, universities, and relevant government initiatives.
Support workforce planning and localization strategies in alignment with business needs and regulatory requirements.
Independently manage daily HR operations, including onboarding, offboarding, employee relations, attendance, leave management, and payroll coordination.
Ensure compliance with Omani Labour Law, Wage Protection System (WPS) requirements, and other applicable employment regulations.
Maintain accurate employee records, employment contracts, and statutory documentation.
Coordinate with relevant government authorities to ensure timely completion of mandatory HR procedures and reporting.
Manage the full lifecycle of expatriate employment and immigration processes, including work permits, employment visas, renewals, sponsorship transfers, and cancellations.
Coordinate with relevant government authorities and external service providers to ensure timely and compliant processing.
Monitor visa and work permit validity to minimize compliance risks and operational disruptions.
Support performance management processes, including performance reviews, employee development, and performance improvement initiatives.
Handle employee relations matters professionally and ensure fair and consistent application of HR policies.
Promote a positive, inclusive, and culturally respectful working environment.
Support the implementation of localized compensation and benefits practices aligned with market standards and company policies.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee information in HR systems (HRIS).
Prepare regular HR reports, including headcount, recruitment, Omanisation, attendance, and other operational metrics.
Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, operational efficiency, and compliance controls.
Support the implementation and localization of regional and global HR policies and procedures.

q: Bachelor’s degree in nursing or Diploma in Nursing
Current and valid license to practice Nursing from home country of qualification required
Current Basic and Advanced Cardiac Life Support training certification

r: The Staff Nurse is responsible for providing clinical care to a defined group of patients and ensuring the maintenance of high standards of patient care within the unit during their span of duty. The post holder is responsible for assessment of care needs of patients, planning programmers of care, implementation and evaluation of these programmers without direct supervision.

The Staff Nurse will be working independently/autonomously and at times without direct supervision, accountable for their own professional practice. Ensuring the safety and well-being of patients and always working in a manner that promotes the patient's privacy, dignity and cultural beliefs.
This includes prioritizing the care needs of patients and appropriately allocating staff maintaining an awareness of the progress of each patients’ care.

Responsible for the implementation and delivery of age-appropriate patient care in the assigned area of practice congruent with the Mission, Vision and Values of Hospital. Ensuring adherence to the Professional Code of Conduct and Scope of Practice of the Ministry of Health Saudia Arabia.
Working in conjunction with the Charge Nurse, this position plays a crucial role in delivering day-to-day levels of excellence in service provision of care across the Wards and Departments.

During some periods you will have management responsibility for being in-charge of the Wards/Department. This will involve supervising junior members of staff. In the event of this you will be required to monitor and review staff still mix in accordance with patient dependency and acuity, utilize available information to align staffing and workload, and communicate with Senior Nursing staff as required.
The post holder will be a key member in relation to the development of practice service standards ensuring they are consistently met.
Acting as a role model, delivering high clinical and operational performance standards, by working effectively as part of the team.

Facilitates effective patient flow, utilizing bed capacity and staffing resources appropriately. Communicates with all unit(s) / departments as appropriate, to maximize efficiency and to expedite the admission, transfer and discharge process.
Collaborates with personnel from non-nursing departments/disciplines regarding issues that may negatively impact patient care; facilitate solutions as needed.
Provides leadership in critical thinking, conflict management and problem solving.
Demonstrate skills and competencies in continual assessment of planning, implementing and evaluating patient care.

Performs nursing interventions/procedures in accordance with established standards of care, policies and procedures. This may involve assisting physicians undertaking diagnostic or therapeutic interventions.
Identifies complications and deviations from the norm and takes appropriate action.
Maintains accurate and thorough documentation and communication following Identify, Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation (ISBAR) principles.
Completes nursing documentation timely and accurately, ensuring that quality standards of nursing documentation are maintained according to Hospital policy.
Maintains required nursing competencies and competencies in the use of all medical equipment including but not limited to, materials necessary for the resuscitation and stabilization of patients.

Safely administer medication according to Hospital policy. Document medication administration accurately, according to protocols. Understands actions of medication and contraindications, evaluates patient’s response, identifies side effects and initiates appropriate action.
Experience in the management of ventilated patients either in an acute care or long-term ventilated facility.
Understand and able to explain the nursing department’s Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
To participate in Department/Hospital-wide quality improvement initiatives including implementation and evaluation of action plans and quality improvement projects.
To work with the Charge Nurse in ensuring safe nursing and clinical practice and that Hospital follows evidence based international practice and accreditation standards.

To assist the Charge Nurse on Quality Assurance and Regulation to ensure delivery of Hospital Risk Strategy and Clinical Risk Training Strategy. To participate in programmers and initiatives to reduce and manage risk and harm to patients.

To assist in serious incident investigations as required and contribute to the response to recommendations and lessons to be learned from investigations and external and regulatory reviews where nursing has come under scrutiny.
Uses information technology to access, transmit and produce information as necessary eg. Incident reporting system.
Contributes to product evaluation at unit levels and participates in trials related to new product lines as appropriate.
Acts as a preceptor to less experienced staff as required.
Actively participates in organizational change in a constructive manner.
Actively participates in the Clinical Competency Programmer.
Actively participates in the process for ensuring the organization achieves and maintains JCIA status.
Engages in health promotion activities in the organization and community.

Responsible to educate patients/families as per their needs and to implement their whole role regarding patient/family education process as per hospital’s policy including documentation in the patient medical record.
Provides health promotion and health teaching thru methods appropriate to a patients’ developmental level, learning needs, readiness and ability to learn, language preference, culture and situations.
Involves the patient/families in plan of care and respects patients/families regarding their goals and choices of patient care.

d: Pavago is seeking a passionate and proactive Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our growing recruitment team. This role plays a critical part in identifying, attracting, and hiring exceptional talent for a diverse range of client positions across multiple industries.

This is more than just sourcing resumes—you will own the recruitment lifecycle from job posting through candidate presentation while delivering an outstanding experience for both candidates and clients. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy connecting great talent with exciting opportunities, and take pride in building strong hiring pipelines, we'd love to hear from you.
q: Previous experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or a similar hiring role.
Strong experience sourcing candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, and networking.
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
Ability to evaluate candidate qualifications and cultural fit.
Experience coordinating multiple recruitment processes simultaneously.
Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment platforms.
Proficiency with video conferencing tools for remote interviews.
Ability to work independently while managing competing priorities.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field.
Experience recruiting for remote or international positions.
Experience working in a recruitment agency or staffing environment.
Knowledge of Boolean search and advanced sourcing techniques.
Experience recruiting across multiple industries and functional roles.
What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

Your day begins by reviewing active hiring priorities, responding to new applications, and sourcing candidates across multiple platforms. Throughout the day, you conduct candidate interviews, coordinate client interviews, communicate with hiring managers, and present qualified candidates for open positions.
You'll maintain ATS records, manage recruitment pipelines, support onboarding activities, and continuously build relationships with talented professionals for future opportunities.
Success in this role comes from consistently identifying high-quality talent, delivering an excellent candidate experience, and helping clients hire exceptional people.
You Are the Right Person If...
You enjoy building relationships with people.
You are naturally curious and know how to uncover great talent.
You can confidently assess candidates through structured interviews.
You stay organized even while managing multiple open roles.
You are proactive, resourceful, and accountable.
You enjoy working in a fast-moving recruitment environment.
r: Create and publish engaging job postings across multiple hiring platforms.
Source high-quality candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, networking, referrals, and other recruitment channels.
Review applications and conduct initial candidate screenings.
Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
Identify passive candidates through proactive sourcing strategies.
Conduct structured interviews to evaluate candidates' technical skills, communication abilities, and cultural fit.
Assess candidate suitability based on client requirements.
Prepare comprehensive interview evaluations and hiring recommendations.
Present shortlisted candidates to clients with detailed profiles highlighting their strengths and qualifications.
Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
Manage interview scheduling and ensure a smooth recruitment experience.
Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout every stage of the hiring process.
Provide timely updates and feedback whenever possible.
Develop a strong understanding of each client's hiring requirements, business goals, and company culture.
Work closely with internal stakeholders to refine candidate profiles and hiring strategies.
Deliver exceptional client service by presenting highly qualified candidates efficiently.
Maintain accurate candidate records within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
Keep recruitment pipelines organized and up to date.
Support onboarding activities to ensure a seamless transition for successful candidates.
Continuously improve recruitment workflows and sourcing strategies.
What Makes You a Strong Fit
You genuinely enjoy connecting talented people with great career opportunities.
You are highly organized and can manage multiple hiring processes simultaneously.
You communicate confidently with candidates, clients, and internal stakeholders.
You proactively solve recruitment challenges instead of waiting for direction.
You take ownership of your roles and consistently deliver results.
You thrive in a remote, fast-paced, and collaborative environment.
